project.name: Nasdanika SDK Roadmap: SVG Charts
project.description: Charts of the chart nano-model written to the runtime's SVG model: bar, line, area, scatter, composed and pie charts, with axes, a grid, reference lines, a legend and tooltips as SVG titles. No charting library: the layout is a few scales and round-number ticks. Named to graduate next to the runtime's SVG model, as org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.models.svg:chart.
